verdict.rationale: Semgrep lets users write custom rules that run automatically on repository events such as pushes, pull/merge requests and commits. Matches can trigger actions like PR code-review comments, autofixes, alerts, notifications or tickets. This is a scan-rule model tied to CI and Git events, not a general event→action automation engine. missing for 10: user-defined mapping of arbitrary events to arbitrary actions, documented per-rule action configuration (e.g. which rule fires which notification or ticket), independent or hands-on corroboration of the automated actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
